regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow and concentrated: only 4 of 17 themes are eligible under the absolute-trend gate, led by Banks with a mixed Hurst tag and crowded flag, while breadth of rotation is just 0.24 (non-directional, one_narrative false). The validated edge here is drawdown control (gate_helps true), not return prediction — so directional views are my own conditional judgment, kept modest. Note: none of the eligible themes (Banks, Energy, High-Dividend, Conglomerates) has a scorable ETF proxy, so every view below is on an unscorable theme and conviction must be low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the narrow eligible set (currently 4 of 17) broadens OR further collapses: an absorption of 0.47 with one_narrative false suggests no single story has taken over, so I am watching for Banks to either confirm a durable handoff (breadth above 0.7 AND crowding_z falling below ~0.5 for two consecutive weeks) or lose trend-gate eligibility — whichever shows first retires this watch.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the eligible set (score 1.575, rank 1) with decent breadth (0.769) and pass the absolute-trend gate. The only validated edge is staying-power via trend discipline; the other legs (rank, durability) are attention/focus, not alpha. Crowding (z 1.06) and a mixed Hurst tag argue for reduced size rather than direction — I keep a low-conviction tilt, not a conviction buy.
theses.dissent: The dominant theme shows a mixed Hurst tag (not a clean trend), is crowded, and the momentum rank has no forward return edge — leadership may be coincident rather than durable.

falsifier.text: Banks break below the absolute-trend gate for two consecutive weekly observations before the 21-day check.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is rank 2 (score 1.165), eligible, with the strongest durability_bar (0.8), a clean trend Hurst tag, and full-ish breadth (0.8). As the main eligible challenger to Banks, it has a coherent trend-health profile — my lean rests on trend-gate plus trend-health rather than any return forecast. The rotation margin (0.41) is not a validated handoff signal, so this is a parallel overweight, not a switch call.
theses.dissent: Rank 2 relative momentum is near-zero alpha, and the rotation detector is display-only — the 'challenger' framing has no confirmed forward timing edge.

falsifier.text: Energy loses its trend status and falls below the absolute-trend gate before the 21-day check.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend is rank 3 (score 0.92), eligible, with a trend Hurst tag and non-crowded texture (z 0.14). As a defensive income theme it passes the only validated discipline (trend gate) and shows trend health. My lean is modest and structurally defensive — not a strength call.
theses.dissent: Its momentum score is well behind Banks and Energy, and any forward edge from rank is insignificant; income themes can lag when financials and cyclicals lead.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend falls below its 0.68 durability_bar and loses eligible status before the 21-day check.
